arguments.value: Yaskawa Electric and Argo formed a long-term strategic alliance to work together on healthcare robotics. Yaskawa would help market and distribute Argo’s exoskeleton products, potentially buy preferred shares in Argo, and use its robotics expertise to improve Argo’s products. Argo would also help distribute future Yaskawa healthcare products. The parties agreed to set up a joint steering committee to coordinate sales, development, manufacturing, and improvement efforts. The agreement lasts 10 years, with possible renewal, and can be ended earlier for material breach or by mutual written consent. It does not create a partnership or joint venture, keeps each side’s intellectual property separate unless a separate license is agreed, requires confidentiality under a separate NDA, bars each side from poaching the other’s personnel for 12 months after the collaboration ends, and is governed by Israeli law with disputes heard in Tel Aviv.
